name: Coherent
description: Coherent makes lasers, optical components and engineered materials (such as silicon carbide and indium phosphide), now sold mainly as datacom transceivers, the optical modules that link AI data-center servers and switches. Its Datacenter & Communications segment (74% of FY2026 revenue, $5.3B, up 40%) sells high-speed transceivers (800G and 1.6T), optical circuit switches and telecom components, while the Industrial segment (26%, $1.8B, down 10%) sells lasers and materials for manufacturing, instrumentation and consumer electronics. It sold its aerospace and defense and Munich businesses in FY2026 for a $124M gain. Two customers each exceeded 10% of FY2026 revenue.

businessLines.name: Datacenter & Communications
businessLines.how: Per-unit sales of transceivers and optical components to cloud and equipment customers, vertically integrated from materials to modules; volume driven by AI datacenter build-outs.
businessLines.description: Datacenter transceivers (800G/1.6T), VCSELs, EMLs, silicon photonics, optical circuit switches, telecom (communications) optical components and lasers.

businessLines.name: Industrial
businessLines.how: Laser systems and components sold per unit to industrial and OEM customers, plus materials; cyclical with manufacturing demand.
businessLines.description: Lasers, optics and engineered materials for precision manufacturing, instrumentation, scientific and consumer electronics applications.
